nodes.label: Client
nodes.description: Requests the home timeline when the user opens the app.

nodes.label: API
nodes.description: Receives the read request and orchestrates the query fan-in.

nodes.label: Follow List
nodes.description: Looked up to find everyone the requesting user follows.

nodes.label: Tweet Store
nodes.description: Queried per-followee for recent tweets, then merged and sorted by time.

nodes.label: Tweet Write
nodes.description: A user posts a new tweet.

nodes.label: Queue
nodes.description: Kafka decouples the write from fan-out so the write API returns immediately.

nodes.label: Fan-out Service
nodes.description: Pushes the new tweet ID into every follower's precomputed timeline cache.

nodes.label: Follower Caches
nodes.description: Per-user Redis sorted set — reading a timeline is now a cheap lookup here.

nodes.label: Timeline Read
nodes.description: Reads directly from the precomputed cache instead of querying tweets live.

nodes.label: Normal-Follow Cache
nodes.description: Precomputed cache, same as the scaled tier — used for accounts below the celebrity threshold.

nodes.label: Celebrity Live Pull
nodes.description: Celebrities skip fan-out entirely; their recent tweets are pulled live at read time instead.

nodes.label: Merge / Sort
nodes.description: Combines the precomputed results with the live celebrity pull and re-sorts by timestamp.

nodes.label: Timeline Response
nodes.description: The final hybrid timeline returned to the client.
